description:
## Problem
- **Tuning profiles still choose an engine.** `benchbox tuning init --platform polars --profile optimized|streaming|memory-constrained` writes Polars `engine_affinity` or `streaming_mode` (`core/dataframe/tuning/profiles.py:28-31,40-44,46-48`; `cli/commands/tuning_group.py:98,195`).
  - A later `run --tuning <file>` records the variant `polars+in-memory` (or `+streaming`) instead of the default row (`platforms/dataframe/polars_df.py:94-107`).
  - This contradicts the CHANGELOG statement that shipped tunings stop choosing an engine (CHANGELOG.md:292-293). A warning is logged, so it is not fully silent.
  - The behaviour is pinned by `tests/unit/cli/test_onboarding_df_tuning_behavioral.py:212-217`.
- **SQL `streaming=True` raises instead of warning.** `PolarsAdapter(streaming=True)` raises `UnsupportedExecutionEngineError` (`platforms/polars_platform.py:143-151,163-164`; `tests/unit/platforms/test_polars_adapter.py:56-62`).
  - In v0.4.2 it was a no-op.
  - ADR D13 says aliases keep working, with a warning, until 0.6.0.
  - There is no "Before you upgrade" entry. The path is API-only.

## Change
- Stop the Polars profiles setting `engine_affinity`, gate `streaming_mode` by platform, and update the pinned tests.
- Treat SQL `streaming=True` as a deprecated alias: warn through the core legacy-option path and record `default`. Or add a "Before you upgrade" entry and an ADR note.
